messages:
Maria Chen: Quick pulse — can we lock pricing runway and SLA OKRs for GA by EOD? Need owners + fallback policy.
Aj Patel: I'm +1. main open Q: p99 latency SLO vs SLA. Ops wants buffer.
Kevin O'Neill: Ops suggests p99 <= 350ms for hosted API under baseline traffic, p95 <= 120ms. can we commit?
Maria Chen: p99 350ms sounds aggressive but ok if we document exception windows.
Sasha Ivanov: We should tier SLAs: Standard (p95 200ms), Premium (p99 350ms + 99.9% uptime). default to Standard.
Elaine Park: Pricing runway: propose three tiers; dev (free tier credits), standard ($0.0025/token), premium ($0.005/token). thoughts?
Samir Noor: math looks okay but needs committed capacity discounts for Dedicated. add a reserved capacity rate: 30% off at 3mo commit.
Aj Patel: Also need billing backstop for massive regressions: auto-fallback to cheaper model + notify billing team.
Kevin O'Neill: Operationally we need SLO burn-rate alerts at 2x and 4x with paging on 4x. Add to runbook.
Maria Chen: Action items: 1) finalize exact SLA numbers 2) finalize price points 3) write fallback policy 4) add runbook alerts. Owners?
Sasha Ivanov: I'll own SLA numbers and runbook updates. ETA Thu.
Elaine Park: I'll own pricing table and dev credits. ETA Wed COB.
Samir Noor: I'll document Dedicated discount tiers + legal notes. ETA Fri.
Aj Patel: I'll add the billing fallback flow and ensure the console shows current model fallback. ETA Thu.
Kevin O'Neill: I'll wire alerts into oncall, set SLO burn thresholds and create pager duty escalation.
Maria Chen: Good. Two quick clarifications: (1) do we include an SLA credit for missed windows? (2) what constitutes "outage"?
Sasha Ivanov: Yes—standard SLA credit: prorated monthly credit up to 50% of monthly bill for prolonged SLA breaches. Define outage = customer-facing 5xx rate > 1% sustained 5m or latency SLO breach > 15 min.
Elaine Park: Pricing note: free tier cap at 100k tokens/month, then dev tier pay-as-you-go. Need copy for docs and marketing.
Samir Noor: Legal flagged language for "SLA credit" — need legal sign-off. Created ticket: <https://tickets.company/SLACredit-1234>
Aj Patel: Also need a kill-switch policy: if regression causes cost blowout we throttle by default and notify customers 1h before enforced throttle. Add to T&Cs.
Kevin O'Neill: For monitoring: add per-route latency dashboards, p95/p99 histograms, and an "SLO health" single-panel for Console.
Maria Chen: Perfect. Plan for a short shiproom tomorrow 10am to review PRs. If owners hit ETAs, we can freeze language for GA next Tue.
deploy-bot: Reminder: docs PR template assigned to @SashaIvanov and @ElainePark — https://git.company/docs/pr/987
Sasha Ivanov: noted :+1: will open draft now.
Elaine Park: I'll include pricing examples for common usage patterns (chat, embeddings) — want a couple of customer-ready screenshots.
Samir Noor: For Dedicated we also need a minimum commitment threshold. propose $10k/mo. Open to negotiation.
Aj Patel: Ok, added to sheet: <https://sheets.company/pricing-runway>
Maria Chen: Thanks all — if anyone hits a blocker ping me. Short summary to PG later today.
